Abstract Text: Worker entered confined space without testing.
Event Description: A technician entered a storage vessel to inspect an internal valve without atmospheric testing. H2S was detected after entry and the worker exited immediately. No injury occurred.

Abstract Text: Worker stood beneath a suspended load.
Event Description: During equipment lifting, a worker entered the exclusion zone and stood beneath a suspended pump. The load remained stable and was lowered without incident.

Abstract Text: Roof worker exposed to a fall hazard.
Event Description: A worker was installing roofing material approximately 25 feet above ground without an effective fall protection system. No fall occurred.

Abstract Text: Electrical maintenance started without verified isolation.
Event Description: An electrician began maintenance on an electrical panel without verifying isolation. The circuit was unexpectedly energized during the task, but the worker stepped away before contact.
A damaged office chair with a loose wheel was found during housekeeping inspection and removed from service. No significant hazard remained.
A worker walked behind a reversing forklift in an active loading area. The operator stopped after noticing the worker, preventing contact.

Abstract Text: Hot work started without permit verification.
Event Description: Contractors began welding near process equipment before the hot work permit was verified and without confirming the required gas test. Work was stopped before ignition.

Abstract Text: Worker sustained a minor hand cut.
Event Description: A worker received a small superficial cut to the hand while opening packaging with a utility knife. First aid was provided.
A worker entered a 10-foot excavation where access was inadequate and loose soil was visible along the edge. The worker exited before any collapse.
A routine inspection found an emergency exit partially blocked by stored cartons. The cartons were removed immediately.
